responsibility: Implements the caching layer behind the GIMPLE ranger. It provides per-SSA per-basic-block on-entry caches, global SSA range caches, dominator-walk lookup and fill logic, edge/outgoing-range integration through gori_compute, and registration of inferred side-effect ranges, allowing repeated range queries to reuse previously computed entry, exit, and global information efficiently during ranger-based analyses and optimizations.
same_name_distinction: Implements the storage and algorithms behind the gimple-range-cache interface: concrete SSA/block cache representations, dominator-walk lookup/fill, cache propagation, and inferred-range registration. Unlike gcc/gimple-range-cache.h, this is the executable implementation rather than the API and class declarations for ranger_cache and related caches.
